description: Search test cases in a project with optional filters. Returns total count and paginated data. Use status/priority name strings (e.g. 'To Do', 'High'). projectId must be numeric (e.g. 10000). Set recursive=true with folderId to count across all subfolders (returns total only, no data).

assignee.description: Filter by assignee Jira account IDs

query.description: Free-text search on summary/key (mapped to the API's searchText filter)

recursive.description: If true and folderId is set, counts test cases across all subfolders. Returns { total, folderCount } only.

response_format.description: Output format. 'markdown' is human-readable; 'json' (default) is machine-readable.

status.description: Filter by status name strings (e.g. ['To Do'])

name: qtm4j_search_test_cases
title: Search Test Cases
